info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Card Terminal Configuration Management API
info.description: The Card Terminal Configuration Management API facilitates the patching and updating of card terminal settings within a banking environment. This endpoint allows authorized users to modify existing configurations for specific card terminals, ensuring they meet current operational requirements. Common consumers of this API include banking administrators and IT professionals who manage terminal operations. This API enables businesses to swiftly adapt to changes in technology or customer needs, enhancing overall terminal efficiency.

patch.summary: Update the card terminal settings for a specific channel.
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update various settings and configurations for a specific card terminal identified by its unique ID within the specified channel. Ensure that you provide the necessary data in the request body to reflect the desired changes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the configuration of a specific card terminal identified by CARD-400045. It should contain the necessary fields to modify the terminal's settings and properties as defined in the schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, and the resource has been updated.
